definitions.ask: Should the Mac's Remote Login get Full Disk Access so the agent can make the root Postfix change?
definitions.why: Keeps the Mac remotely repairable; the /crontab skill already names it as the Mac EPERM fix

choices.label: You enable remote-user Full Disk Access; the agent does every root step over SSH
Remote Login stays locked down; you paste the root commands on the Mac, now and after upgrades
